metin.SexyKO'da karakterinizin nickini değişti: Changing your character's nick in SexyKO is now much easier.
metin.Oyuncular, Power Up Store üzerinden **Sc: Players can buy the **Scroll of Identity** item from the Power Up Store and change their nick directly, without going to any NPC.
metin.**1️⃣** Power Up Store üzerinden **Scrol: **1️⃣** Buy a **Scroll of Identity** from the Power Up Store.
metin.**3️⃣** Scroll'u kullanarak açılan nick: **3️⃣** Use the scroll to open the nick change window.
metin.**5️⃣** İşlemi onaylayarak karakter adın: **5️⃣** Confirm to change your character name.
metin.Açılan pencere üzerinden kullanmak isted: In the window that opens, you can set the new character name you want to use.
metin.NPC aramanıza gerek kalmaz,: you don't need to look for an NPC,
metin.farklı bir bölgeye gitmenize gerek kalma: you don't need to go to another zone,
metin.nick değiştirme işlemini bulunduğunuz ye: you can complete the nick change right where you are.
metin.Yeni nickinizi yazarken doğru olduğundan: Make sure your new nick is correct when typing it.
metin.İşlemi onaylamadan önce karakter adınızı: Always check your character name before confirming.
metin.**PUS'tan Scroll of Identity al → Sağ tı: **Get a Scroll of Identity from PUS → Right-click → Type your new nick → Confirm**
metin.Yeni nickini seç, karakterini yenile!: Pick your new nick, refresh your character!
